title: Practical Guidelines for Ideology Detection Pipelines and Psychosocial Applications
benchmark_measurement: Usage of 'god' related language as a category of grievance speech across different ideological groups.
findings: In the grievance analysis of the #Ausvotes dataset, far-right users were found to use 'god' type language less than other ideological groups.
